name: Pythagorean theorem
description: Show why a^2 + b^2 = c^2 for a right triangle using squares built on each side.

name: The derivative as slope
description: Show secant lines on a curve approaching the tangent line as the two points get closer.

name: Sine and cosine on the unit circle
description: Show a point moving around the unit circle and how its x and y coordinates trace out cosine and sine.

name: Area of a circle
description: Show why a circle's area is pi r^2 by cutting it into thin wedges and rearranging them into a near-rectangle.

name: Matrix multiplication
description: Show how each entry of a matrix product is a row of the first matrix dotted with a column of the second.

name: Binary search
description: Show binary search finding a number in a sorted array by repeatedly halving the search range.

name: Bayes' theorem
description: Show how a prior probability is updated by evidence, using a population split into groups.

name: Linear transformations
description: Show a 2x2 matrix transforming the plane, with the grid lines and basis vectors moving to their new positions.

name: Recursion
description: Explain recursion with factorial, showing the call stack growing and then unwinding.

name: Entropy (information theory)
description: Explain entropy as the average surprise of outcomes, comparing a fair coin to a biased coin.

name: Big-O notation
description: Explain Big-O by comparing how n, n log n, and n^2 grow as the input size gets large.

name: The halting problem
description: Explain why no program can decide whether every program halts, using the self-referential contradiction.
